title: First steps: platform, application and your infobase
goal: Find or install a lawful training platform, open your own empty infobase and explain why an empty application window is the correct first result.
prerequisites: Be able to open a folder and a text file in Windows.
No ready-made 1C application configuration is required.
outcomes: Separate platform, configuration and data using a concrete example.
Distinguish developing a learning application from operating real business records.
Choose a free learning path and explain its limits.
sections: “Install 1C” is an incomplete specification. The platform supplies common mechanisms: windows, infobase access, module execution and data operations. A configuration describes a domain: which customers, requests and services exist, what can be saved and how results are calculated. An infobase holds a particular application instance and its data. Several infobases can use one installed platform. A shortcut label therefore does not establish that the intended infobase is open.

In our service desk, Request as a future document type belongs to the configuration. Request REQ-001 from invented customer Alpha is data. Version 8.3.27.2214 identifies the platform. Confusing these layers can make you mistake a software update for a data transfer or submit configuration sources instead of completed work. Separate the layers before making your first change.

Think of a text editor: the installed program is not the same thing as your document. Similarly, one 1C platform installation can open several independent infobases. In this course, Training service desk is the application we build ourselves, not a third-party product to download. We begin with our own empty infobase; customers and requests appear after we define their objects.

The platform does not inherently know what “request closed” means. The application defines that rule. Identical words in different configurations may represent different actions. Saving generally persists an object state; posting reflects a business event according to configuration rules. Posting does not automatically mean payment or completion. A1 establishes vocabulary and a model; actual catalogs and documents are introduced in later modules.

The learning model contains three requests lasting 30, 45 and 30 minutes. Their sum is 105 minutes, but this is not yet revenue, employee workload or paid labor: we have not defined those rules. A careful user checks the meaning, unit and selection behind a metric before drawing conclusions. This habit is more useful than memorizing button positions.

A beginner has two separate questions: which application window am I using, and what has already been created in my infobase? The title and launch command answer the first. Configuration and saved data answer the second. Instructions for a different accounting or payroll application need not match an empty training infobase: commands, business rules and protected objects can differ.

The main free route uses the official version for learning programming supplied by 1C. If a suitable platform is already lawfully installed, first check its version and suitability for your own training infobase. Do not copy keys, licenses or third-party configurations. The conditions of the chosen distribution apply whether you launch it from a shortcut or another tool.

The training edition is for learning and has limitations. These labs do not demonstrate a multi-user deployment, password-based access protection or real business operations. Begin with a file infobase, one session and invented records. Nexus does not redistribute the platform: obtain it from its rights holder. A professional environment is considered separately when a task actually needs one.
Record a result that can be checked

Record the application name, a safe infobase alias and the full platform version separately. A configuration version does not replace a platform version. An unlabeled screenshot does not explain the operation tested. A concise protocol includes the action, expected result, observed result and limits of the conclusion.

Without an installed platform, you can study theory and classify items with the interactive diagram. This is useful preparation, but it is not 1C execution. Diagram buttons explain a model; they do not create an infobase or execute BSL. Attest a laboratory step only after observing it in the official environment.

The first observable result is deliberately concrete: your infobase appears in the startup list, Designer displays a metadata tree, and Enterprise mode opens without application sections. An empty window is normal because we have not described the application yet. Marking the lesson complete in Nexus records your self-report; it does not create a configuration or install the platform.

exercises.task: Classify “8.3.27”, “Customers catalog” and “Training North” by layer. Explain each choice.
exercises.criteria: Version: platform; catalog definition: configuration; a particular customer name: data. You need not create the catalog yet.

exercises.task: Suppose one PC lists two infobases under the same visible name. Explain how to distinguish them before opening either.
exercises.criteria: Check their locations and give your own training entries distinct names. Do not delete an entry at random.

exercises.task: Create your empty training infobase using the route below. Close it and reopen Designer from the same startup entry. Describe the first result in your own words.
exercises.criteria: The same infobase reopens; distinguish the startup list, Designer and Enterprise mode.

lab.title: Your first empty infobase
lab.environment: An ordinary official training platform installation on your PC; a separate file infobase with no third-party configuration.
steps: Expand the installation instructions in this lesson. If a suitable lawful installation is missing, obtain the official training distribution, extract the whole ZIP with Extract all and follow the 1C installer. Then find 1C:Enterprise in the Windows Start menu.

Select Add → create a new infobase. Choose an infobase without a configuration for development. Name your entry “My training service desk”. Select a new empty directory in your own study documents for the file infobase and finish the wizard.
Open Designer. If the tree is hidden, choose Configuration → Open configuration. Find the root and the Catalogs section. Do not change any properties yet.

Close your training Designer. Select the same entry and open Enterprise mode. Inspect the empty application, close it, then reopen Designer from the same entry. Write down the three layers in your study notes.
expected: The standard 1C startup list or official installed shortcut opens.
Your new entry points to your new directory.
Designer displays the object categories of your own empty infobase.
Both modes open from your own entry; missing application sections are explained by the absence of objects.
evidence: A clear name for your training infobase and the actual platform version, without license numbers.
A screenshot of your own empty configuration tree, free of personal data, and an explanation of the three layers.
Reopening the same infobase in both modes; the Nexus completion mark is stored separately.
lab.negative: Open the empty application and explain why Customers is absent. Do not reinstall the platform or delete the infobase: its objects have not been created.

mistakes: There is no Customers catalog after installation.
That is expected for an empty infobase. We will create the catalog ourselves; the installed platform does not contain your service desk records.
I opened another infobase with a similar name.
Close it without changes. Check the location of your own training entry and adjust only its descriptive startup-list name.
The other mode will not open.
Check whether the previous training session is closed. Do not terminate unrelated processes or delete lock files.
Nexus stores the lesson and self-report. The installed 1C application opens and changes the infobase. Actions in one program do not perform the required actions in the other.

quiz.question: Where is the rule “status has three allowed values” defined?
quiz.explanation: Configuration defines domain rules; a record stores one value.

quiz.question: What can the Nexus diagram demonstrate?
options: Understanding the model when correctly explained
quiz.explanation: It is a visualization and does not call the platform.

quiz.question: What is 30 + 45 + 30 minutes?
quiz.explanation: Keep the unit and do not invent an economic meaning.

examples.source:
1C platform → infobase “My training desk”
The same platform → another training infobase
examples.expected: Opening the second infobase does not copy customers from the first.
examples.explanation: The platform supplies mechanisms; records belong to the selected infobase. A shortcut name does not replace checking which location you open.
trace: The second database is not merged in.
You switched infobases rather than clearing the first.

examples.title: Why installation does not produce requests
examples.source:
1. Install the platform.
2. Create an infobase without a configuration.
3. Open Enterprise mode.
examples.expected: An empty application window; no customer or request objects yet.
examples.explanation: We installed the engine and created a container, but have not described our application. Reinstalling the platform will not supply the missing configuration.

steps.title: Find or install the training platform
steps.where: Nexus → common lab instructions; then the official 1C installer
steps.before: Working infobases are closed; you know whether installation is needed.
steps.action: Expand the installation instructions in this lesson. If a suitable lawful installation is missing, obtain the official training distribution, extract the whole ZIP with Extract all and follow the 1C installer. Then find 1C:Enterprise in the Windows Start menu.
steps.why: Later actions require the real program rather than a syntax-highlighted web page.
steps.expected: The standard 1C startup list or official installed shortcut opens.
steps.troubleshooting: Extract the complete archive into a new directory first. Do not run files from the archive preview; use the common installation guide for details.

steps.title: Create a separate empty infobase
steps.before: The list shows existing infobases; leave them unchanged.
steps.action: Select Add → create a new infobase. Choose an infobase without a configuration for development. Name your entry “My training service desk”. Select a new empty directory in your own study documents for the file infobase and finish the wizard.
steps.why: A separate directory keeps experiments apart from other people’s work and business records.
steps.expected: Your new entry points to your new directory.
steps.troubleshooting: If the wizard offers application templates, return to the empty-infobase option. Do not load a third-party configuration or select a directory already in use.

steps.title: Compare the second mode and reopen the infobase
steps.where: Designer and the standard 1C startup list
steps.action: Close your training Designer. Select the same entry and open Enterprise mode. Inspect the empty application, close it, then reopen Designer from the same entry. Write down the three layers in your study notes.
steps.why: Switching modes neither creates catalogs nor deletes the infobase. Reopening checks which location you selected.
steps.expected: Both modes open from your own entry; missing application sections are explained by the absence of objects.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not delete the infobase because the window is empty. If the training edition permits one session, close the previous session before changing modes.
